feature_sets.name: Local usage reconstruction
feature_sets.workflow: Select authorized source → parse provider usage → deduplicate → normalize deltas → retain history
feature_sets.decision: Implemented normalized and Claude/Codex usage imports plus metadata-only completed Claude tool pairs. Replay identities remain stable. Explicit multi-source configuration is implemented. More native tools and a correction protocol remain planned. Completed Claude CLI result snapshots supply per-model cumulative deltas and client-side estimates without private transcript discovery. One task-owned Claude Code 2.1.308 native JSONL source now has actual first-message, resumed append, metadata projection, disjoint-token, API-revision and private dashboard proof. Repeated identical usage with different row timestamps keeps the first source event time. Changed accepted usage refuses. An in-memory Claude follower now reads complete appended lines incrementally, detects replacement/truncation, and keeps first accepted time for timestamp-only replay; actual owned-source idle/restart checks and fictional rotation/partial-line checks pass. Native Codex, provider-driven rotation, changed-usage correction, larger histories and general lifecycle remain unqualified.

feature_sets.name: Sessions, workers and live observation
feature_sets.workflow: Receive lifecycle evidence → relate sessions and children → follow in terminal or web → inspect chronology → retain stale observations
feature_sets.decision: Implemented metadata hierarchy, evidence aging, explicit multi-file health/coverage, private setup checks and read-only ingestion readiness against a disposable ledger copy. Scoped chronological entity-history pages preserve process identity and one ledger revision. Shared contextual navigation is adopted without runtime authority. Native usage still supplies no live worker lifecycle; process discovery and full native lifecycle adapters remain deferred. Optional runtime-owned normalized emission is qualified against one actual task-owned Claude review process, including running observations, heartbeats, terminal outcome and conversation-usage joining. Sessions offers scoped parent-first hierarchy and local collapse. An optional original adapter reads one selected existing CodeBurn menubar status output as replaceable recent-transcript-write evidence with source age and anonymous aliases. Its actual old, empty source proves unknown-visibility handling, not live-worker coverage. Core native provider collectors and broad discovery remain unqualified.

feature_sets.name: Qualified token and cost analysis
feature_sets.workflow: Filter usage → compare model/provider/surface/project/date → inspect token composition → qualify cost coverage → view explicit currency conversion
feature_sets.decision: Implemented detailed UTC period reports and qualified comparisons, project/model/day breakdowns, timed-record statistics and categorized tool activity. Unsupported workflow quality remains unavailable. Richer charts and configurable views remain planned. An explicitly selected CodeBurn v74 daily cache supplies separate replaceable local-calendar aggregates, with source-reported USD of unknown billing basis and independent read/file ages. No sessions or ledger events are invented. Separate daily provider/model views preserve absent attribution and legacy unknown counters without cross-filtering marginals or summing across days.

feature_sets.name: Provider quota and reset awareness
feature_sets.workflow: Use authorized supported quota source → capture named windows and reset times → show current or last-known usage with age
feature_sets.decision: Implemented normalized quota imports and opt-in installed Codex account/rateLimits/read. Native source qualified through an existing authorized login. Values retain age, reset state and unknown coverage. No hooks, login changes or credentials copied.

feature_sets.name: Pace, forecasts and budget notifications
feature_sets.workflow: Observe supported usage windows → estimate pace with explicit assumptions → compare budget → explain forecast or issue an authorized notification
feature_sets.decision: Implemented selected-window token pace and linear one-hour scenarios with observed span, sample count, heuristic confidence and partial price coverage. Budget notifications and quota-exhaustion forecasting remain planned. No automatic reset or paid overage.

feature_sets.name: Connected and distributed agent tracing
feature_sets.workflow: Configure authorized producer → ingest metadata spans → preserve causal hierarchy → inspect calls and failures across connected systems
feature_sets.decision: Metadata producer contract implemented. Receivers, cloud accounts and distributed tracing UI planned.
